en.headline: Hong Kong Wetland Park offers free admission on National Ecology Day
en.dek: Visitors can enter without tickets on Saturday and join free guided tours in the wetland reserve, as part of wider government and NGO activities.
body: The Hong Kong Wetland Park in Tin Shui Wai is offering free admission on Saturday to mark National Ecology Day, allowing visitors to enter directly through the visitor centre without booking or tickets between 10 a.m. and 5 p.m.

The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department said free public guided tours are available in the wetland reserve. Parking charges remain at HK$8 per hour. Some exhibition galleries and visitor facilities are temporarily closed for upgrading works.

The government and more than 30 non-governmental organisations are running related activities through August and September, including ecological guided tours at country parks, firefly-watching tips at Tai Po Kau Nature Reserve, free entry at other nature sites such as Fung Yuen Butterfly Reserve, and double Green$ points for recycling at GREEN@COMMUNITY facilities on the day (excluding food-waste recycling).

zh.headline: 全國生態日香港濕地公園免費開放 設公眾導賞
zh.dek: 天水圍濕地公園周六全日免費入場，市民可直接經訪客中心進入，並參加濕地保護區免費導賞團。
body: 為慶祝全國生態日，天水圍香港濕地公園於周六上午十時至下午五時免費開放，訪客可直接經訪客中心進入，無需預約或購票。
漁農自然護理署表示，濕地保護區設有免費公眾導賞團。停車場收費維持每小時八元。訪客中心部分展覽廊及設施因進行提升工程暫時關閉。
政府聯同逾三十個非政府機構在八月至九月期間推出多項活動，包括郊野公園生態導賞、大埔滘自然護理區螢火蟲觀賞分享、鳳園蝴蝶保育區等其他地點免費開放，以及當日在「綠在區區」回收可獲雙倍綠綠賞積分（不適用於廚餘回收）。
